style: Say softly and calmly, like a mindfulness teacher
lines: Welcome to Body Thermostat. Change the air, clothes or activity, then press Play and watch the core temperature hold.
Experiment. Switch one response on or off, press Run trial, then switch it back and run it again.
Fever. Press Fever starts, then Play, and watch the body warm itself up to a new set point.
Sweating switched on. Sweat cools you only as it evaporates.
Shivering switched on. Muscles are working just to make heat.
Skin vessels tightened. Warm blood stays in the core.
The air is humid, so sweat can't evaporate fast enough.
Trial added. Now change one thing and press Run trial again.
Two trials. Press Compare to lay their curves on top of each other.
Chills. The core is normal, but the set point says it is too cold.
Fever breaks. The set point drops, so the body sweats and flushes.
Model heat limit. In real life, suspected heat stroke is an emergency. Call 911 and cool the person. Press Reset to start again.
Model cold limit. In real life, hypothermia needs urgent medical help. Get warm and dry. Press Reset to start again.
Trial stopped at the model heat limit. In real life, suspected heat stroke is an emergency. Call 911 and cool the person.
Trial stopped at the model cold limit. In real life, hypothermia needs urgent medical help. Get warm and dry.
Follow the solid and dotted traces. Check the notebook to see what changed, then run a new trial with one change.
Lab. Change the air, clothes or activity, then press Play. Watch which response switches on.
Experiment. Switch one response on or off, press Run trial, then switch it back and press Run trial again. Then press Compare.
Fever. Press Fever starts to raise the target, then Play. Compare core temperature with the set point.
Change Air, Clothes or Activity while the clock runs. Press Pause to inspect the responses.
Paused. Change a condition, then press Play to continue. Press Reset for a fresh trace.
Pick two trial numbers in the notebook, then press Compare. Change one condition to make a controlled pair.
Watch the Compare box and the dashed set point. Press Fever breaks to lower the target again.
Trial added. Change one condition and press Run trial again, or pick two rows and press Compare.
